TcgVariant.title: TcgVariant
TcgVariant.description: Defines a TCG engine ruleset variant, its base variant protocol specification, and 21-digit variable, function, and code-string registers for EDOPro Custom Project Clones.

name.description: Display name of the TCG engine variant.

baseVariantId.description: Canonical base variant identifier required for client protocol compatibility.

resourceName.description: Name of the primary tactical resource (e.g. Summon/Chain, Mana, Energy, Flux).

startingLife.description: Initial player life total in this variant (64-bit integer projection).

startingHandSize.description: Initial cards drawn at match start.

maxResourcePool.description: Maximum resource or zone cap per player.

combatRule.description: Combat resolution model (ATK_DEF_BATTLE, DIRECT_STRIKE, BLOCKER_ASSIGN, SHIELD_MATRIX).

isBaseStandard.description: True if this variant strictly adheres to the unmodified base variant specification.

protocolHash.description: Deterministic compatibility signature for client handshake validation.

maxDigitPrecision.description: Maximum supported numeric digit precision for variables, functions, and code strings (up to 21 digits for EDOPro Custom Clones).

startingLp21.description: Up to 21-digit numeric string (^[0-9]{1,21}$) representing starting LP in EDOPro Custom Clones.

customVarInput21.description: Up to 21-digit numeric string (^[0-9]{1,21}$) for the custom project variable register.

customFuncInput21.description: Up to 21-digit numeric string (^[0-9]{1,21}$) for the custom project function input argument.

customFuncName.description: Identifier of the 21-digit custom function (e.g. ADD_21, MUL_21, SUB_21, MOD_21, SCALE_ATK_LP_21).

customFuncResult21.description: Up to 21-digit numeric string result evaluated by the custom project function.

customCodeString21.description: Up to 21-digit numeric code string (^[0-9]{1,21}$) for EDOPro script/card coding variables (c<21-digits>.lua).

customCodeVarExpr21.description: Code string expression containing coding variables whose numerical digits are strictly capped at 21 digits.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ClientNode.title: ClientNode
ClientNode.description: Represents an external or peer TCG client included in the engine that connects when using its base variant or EDOPro Custom Clone with 21-digit variable, function, and code-string support.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated owner managing this client bridge.

clientName.description: Display name of the external TCG client.

endpointUri.description: Endpoint address or relay channel URI for the client.

baseVariantId.description: The base variant ID required by this client to establish a connection.

baseVariantName.description: Human-readable name of the client's base variant.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version string expected by the client.

requiresStrictBase.description: Whether the client enforces unmodified base variant parameters before connecting.

connectionStatus.description: Current connection state of the client node.

latencyMs.description: Measured handshake round-trip latency in milliseconds.

maxDigitPrecision.description: Maximum numeric digits supported by client variables, functions, and code strings (21 for EDOPro Custom Clone).

customVarInput21.description: 21-digit variable register value (^[0-9]{1,21}$) configured on the client.

customFuncInput21.description: 21-digit function argument value (^[0-9]{1,21}$) configured on the client.

customFuncName.description: Active 21-digit function bound to the client.

customFuncResult21.description: 21-digit output computed by the client function register.

customCodeString21.description: Up to 21-digit numeric code string (^[0-9]{1,21}$) for EDOPro script/card coding variables.

customCodeVarExpr21.description: Code string expression with coding variables capped at 21 numerical digits.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when client was registered via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last status update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CustomDeck.title: CustomDeck
CustomDeck.description: A user-built TCG deck and signature custom card bound to a specific base variant, supporting up to 21-digit ATK/DEF/variable/code-string inputs in EDOPro Custom Clones.

baseVariantId.description: Target base variant ID this deck is legal in.

cardIds.description: Bounded list of card template IDs included in the deck (max 40).

customCardName.description: Name of the deck's forged signature card.

customCardCost.description: Resource cost or Level/Rank of the signature card.

customAttack21.description: Up to 21-digit numeric string (^[0-9]{1,21}$) for custom card ATK.

customDefense21.description: Up to 21-digit numeric string (^[0-9]{1,21}$) for custom card DEF.

customVarInput21.description: Up to 21-digit numeric string passed to the card's ocgcore Lua script variables/functions.

customCodeString21.description: Up to 21-digit numeric code string (^[0-9]{1,21}$) for the card's c<code_string>.lua identifier.

customCodeVarExpr21.description: Code string expression for coding variables with a strict 21-numerical-digit limit.

customCardAbility.description: Rules text ability of the signature card.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

MatchSession.title: MatchSession
MatchSession.description: A live multi-client TCG tabletop match session synced across connected base-variant clients.

hostUserId.description: UID of the user who created the match session.

hostName.description: Display name of the host player.

baseVariantId.description: Enforced base variant ID for all connected clients in this match.

baseVariantName.description: Human-readable name of the enforced base variant.

resourceName.description: Resource label for the match variant.

connectedClients.description: Bounded list of connected client node names participating in the session (max 10).

activePhase.description: Current turn phase (DRAW, MAIN, COMBAT, END).

hostLife.description: Current life total of the host player.

opponentLife.description: Current life total of the connected client / opponent.

hostResources.description: Available tactical resources for the host player.

hostMaxResources.description: Maximum unlocked tactical resources for the host player.

opponentResources.description: Available tactical resources for the opponent client.

hostBoardCards.description: Bounded list of serialized board unit descriptors for host (max 12).

opponentBoardCards.description: Bounded list of serialized board unit descriptors for opponent client (max 12).

actionLog.description: Bounded list of recent match & client protocol log entries (max 20).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the match session.

winnerName.description: Name of the winner once status reaches FINISHED, or empty string while ongoing.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

DiscordServerHub.title: DiscordServerHub
DiscordServerHub.description: Represents a Discord role-playing server and channel bridged to a NexusTCG engine variant.

guildId.description: Discord Guild Snowflake ID or server identifier.

serverName.description: Name of the Discord role-playing server.

baseVariantId.description: TCG engine base variant used by this Discord RP server.

rpLoreSetting.description: Roleplay setting and TCG rules summary for this server.

isConnected.description: Whether the server bridge is currently active.

memberCount.description: Number of roleplayers/duelists in the Discord server.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

RpCharacterPersona.title: RpCharacterPersona
RpCharacterPersona.description: A TCG role-playing character persona used to act in-character and announce TCG plays in Discord servers.

characterName.description: In-character display name used in Discord messages.

factionOrArchetype.description: Character's TCG deck archetype or faction.

baseVariantId.description: Primary TCG base variant this character duels in.

signatureCardName.description: Name of the character's ace/signature card.

signatureCodeString21.description: Up to 21-digit numeric code string (^[0-9]{1,21}$) for the character's signature card.

currentLp21.description: Up to 21-digit numeric string (^[0-9]{1,21}$) tracking the character's current RP Life Points.

summonChant.description: In-character chant spoken when summoning their signature card.

isActivePersona.description: Whether this character is the currently active proxy persona.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

DiscordRpMessage.title: DiscordRpMessage
DiscordRpMessage.description: A Discord channel chat message or in-character TCG roleplay action reviewed or sent from NexusTCG.

userId.description: UID of the user managing this Discord RP feed.

senderName.description: Character name or Discord username of the sender.

senderTitle.description: Roleplay title or Discord role badge of the sender.

isCharacterProxy.description: True if sent while acting as a TCG roleplay character.

messageType.description: Category of the Discord RP message.

tcgActionSummary.description: Embedded TCG system state (LP, summoned card, 21-digit register/code string).

baseVariantId.description: TCG base variant associated with the message.

deliveryStatus.description: Delivery or sync state with Discord.

reviewedFlag.description: Whether the message has been reviewed/verified for TCG roleplay rulings.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

MatchGameEvent.title: MatchGameEvent
MatchGameEvent.description: An immutable persistent game event log entry synchronized in real time via Firestore under a match session (e.g. 'Player 1 played card X', 'Life points reduced by 5').

actorUserId.description: UID of the authenticated user whose client emitted the game event.

actorLabel.description: Display name or seat label of the player/client who performed the action.

eventType.description: Structured category of the game event.

summary.description: Primary human-readable game event message (e.g. 'Player 1 played Card X' or 'Life points reduced by 5').

detail.description: Optional secondary telemetry (zone coordinates, stats, or LP before/after).

turnNumber.description: Match turn number when the event occurred.

activePhase.description: Active turn phase when the event occurred.

cardName.description: Card name associated with the event, or empty string if not card-specific.

lifeDelta.description: Signed life point change associated with the event (e.g. -5, -1000, +500, or 0).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of event persistence via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/variants/{variantId}.description: User-saved TCG engine variants and base-variant rule configurations.

/users/{userId}/clients/{clientId}.description: External and peer TCG clients registered by the user for base-variant connections.

/users/{userId}/decks/{deckId}.description: User-forged TCG decks and custom cards scoped to a base variant.

/matches/{matchId}.description: Live multi-client TCG tabletop match sessions.

/matches/{matchId}/events/{eventId}.description: Persistent chronological game event log synchronized in real time between connected clients.

/users/{userId}/discordServers/{serverId.description: Discord role-playing servers and channels bridged to the user's TCG engine.

/users/{userId}/rpCharacters/{characterI.description: Role-playing character personas for acting in-character in Discord TCG servers.

/users/{userId}/discordMessages/{message.description: Reviewed and sent Discord role-playing chat messages and TCG duel actions.
